objective: Future-only fixed initial ATR14x2 pre-arm protective stop vs unchanged natural MR40 exit: preserve fee/slip-adjusted net profit and reduce intraposition equity DD. Never optimize on already seen samples.
prior_methods_NOT_rerun: Historical static 4/6/8% stops, ratchet after 2% profit, early 3/6-bar fuse, 25/50/75/100% cash splits; all previously tested.

market.fixed_mr40: lookback 40 prior fully closed bars; Z<=-2 entry, Z>=0 natural exit, first Momentum30 episode close[j]>=close[j-180]. Following 4h OPEN is hypothetical and never a proven fill.
market.public_source: daily official Bybit BTCUSDT Spot trade gzip archives only, read after full UTC day completes AND publication. Oct23 already separately fixed by prior research contract.

candidate.atr_aggregation: arithmetic mean of last 14 fully CLOSED 4h true ranges including completed signal bar and never entry bar
candidate.protective_initial_stop: hypothetical following 4h entry OPEN minus 2*ATR14 from signal-close history
candidate.gap_handling: if next held 4h bar opens below stop use OPEN instead of unreachable stop as counterfactual exit-price basis

prospective_evaluation.primary: candidate vs baseline same starting capital: fee and stress slip adjusted terminal equity/net PNL, full intraposition model LOW equity maximum drawdown, stop gap events, holding hours and stop frequency
prospective_evaluation.pass_only_when: stress adjusted terminal equity candidate >= baseline AND modeled max intraposition drawdown candidate <= 80% of baseline; minimum 12 completed forward positions
prospective_evaluation.even_if_pass: research screen ONLY; no automatic paper deployment or edge guarantee
